svg.text: API Gateway to Lambda integration patterns (Todos REST API)
Same routes and DynamoDB table in all three. Only the API Gateway to Lambda wiring changes.
A. Single-purpose Lambda: 5 functions, one per route
C. Lambda Web Adapter (Express): 1 function, Express unchanged
